support_claim: Evidence links the billing referent and contract referent through shared name and retainer activity, but every proposition establishes only ancillary facts and none establishes referent identity or distinctness.

propositions.proposition: Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
propositions.relevance: Links Meridian Energy Partners billing activity to the MSA-MER-2024 contract referenced by the right referent, but does not by itself establish that the two referents denote the same legal counterparty.

propositions.proposition: The billed name on invoices is Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left billing referent in invoice billing records as the entity billed under that name.

propositions.proposition: MSA-MER-2024 is an advisory retainer agreement with counterparty Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
propositions.relevance: Identifies the counterparty named on the contract document referenced by the right referent; name correspondence with billing alone is insufficient to establish referent identity.
